title: Another World
tagline: Another World is a Ready-Player-One-like NFT FPS game where treasures are NFTs and friends are teaming up to hunt them.
description: Another World is a place where treasures are NFTs for friends to team up and hunt them. It is based on the worlds in the Ready Player One. We showcase a local dual-player FPS game where two players use their ENS to join and to receive ERC1155 rewards from OP and Polygon. Two players spawn in a dungeon and start to fight zombies. Will you get the treasure?
how_its_made: This game is built on Unreal Engine 4 using open-sourced templates and assets. ENS is integrated as player ID to receive ERC1155 airdrops (stored on IPFS) from OP and Polygon. We use Infura and QuickNode as Json RPC providers. A solidity server operator contract is deployed for airdropping tokens. Firebase cloud functions are managing the operator contract. Firebase hosting is used for the official website. All codes are in Github public repo.
